final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.ID AS id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.ALB) AS alb, AVG(l.UN * 1.0 / l."T-BIL") AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), s AS (SELECT sex, AVG(alb) AS A, AVG(ratio) AS R FROM g GROUP BY sex), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM s) SELECT s.sex, s.A, s.R, s.A - b.B AS diff FROM s JOIN b ON b.B IS NOT NULL WHERE s.A > b.B
